entities.name: Déogratias Nsabimana
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Déogratias Nsabimana was a general and Chief of Staff of the Rwandan Armed Forces (FAR), under President Habyarimana from April 1992 until he was killed on 6 April 1994 alongside Habyarimana. He also served as Minister of Defense.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Déogratias Nsabimana was a general and Chief of Staff of the Rwandan Armed Forces (FAR), under President Habyarimana from April 1992 until he was killed on 6 April 1994 alongside Habyarimana. He also served as Minister of Defense.
